# Gravel

**Gravel** is a solid (drilled tile by tile) ore. Each extraction yields **1** units, and the zone holds it in finite **deposits (nodes)** — when a node is mined below its threshold it is removed and the zone regenerates nodes up to its configured maximum. How the node-generation columns below are used by the server is in [Ore fields](/it/formats/ore-fields/).

## Estrazione

| Property | Valore |
|---|---|
| Quantità / estrazione | 1 |
| Tipo di estrazione | solid (drilled tile by tile) |
| Effetto attivatore | non richiesto |
| Documento di geo-scansione | definition 5388 |


This ore has no zone node configuration — it is not regenerated in any zone (it exists as a material for production and missions).
